activity_summary: At the gate of the Theatre you looked toward Shoreditch church under the full moon. You were still at the Theatre. You did not go into the church.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked toward the church, and did not enter it.

entities.name: the full moon
entities.context: Mentioned in The moon, from the gate

facets.activity: Saw the full moon over Shoreditch church from the gate
